# 20CLIPS

> 20CLIPS is a remote short-form video editing service. Clients send raw footage to a shared folder and receive 20 ready-to-publish vertical videos every month, formatted for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts, for a flat $999 a month (US dollars). Every video includes captions and subtitles, b-roll, sound design and music, basic motion graphics, hook and pacing optimization, 9:16 delivery and 2 revisions. There are no per-video fees and no long-term commitment. Clients include creators, brands, agencies, podcasters and founders in the UAE, the UK, Australia and worldwide.

Key facts: price $999 per month in US dollars; 20 videos per month (about $50 each); 2 revisions per video; no long-term commitment, cancel anytime; remote service with a shared folder; onboarding by a 30-minute call where turnaround and delivery schedule are agreed; the service edits footage supplied by the client and does not write scripts, film, post or license music. Contact: 20clips.com@gmail.com. Book a call: https://calendly.com/20clips-com/30min
